facts.fact: Renewal student applications on NSP (e.g. the PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship, CSSS) are open till 31-10-2026
facts.quote: Scheme Open from (for Renewal): 01-06-2026 Student Application Open till (for Renewal): 31-10-2026

facts.fact: For almost all other Central Sector schemes on NSP, student applications are also open till 31-10-2026 (e.g. National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship)
facts.quote: National Means Cum Merit Scholarship (Merit Based Scheme) by Department of School Education & Literacy --> Scheme Open from : 01-06-2026 Student Application Open till : 31-10-2026
facts.note: Every Central Sector scheme row on the page shows 31-10-2026 except PM YASASVI Top Class Education in Schools (next fact).

facts.fact: Exception: PM YASASVI Top Class Education in Schools for OBC, EBC and DNT students opened for fresh applications on 22-10-2026 and takes student applications till 30-11-2026 (its institute verification till 15-12-2026, DNO/SNO/MNO verification till 31-12-2026)
facts.was: student applications (fresh and renewal) are open till 31-10-2026, with no exception
facts.quote: PM YASASVI Central Sector Scheme Of Top Class Education In Schools For OBC, EBC And DNT Students (Merit Based Scheme) by Department of Social Justice & Empowerment(Backward Classes) --> Scheme Open from : 22-10-2026 Student Application Open till : 30-11-2026

facts.fact: The portal opened for academic year 2026-27 on 1 June 2026
facts.quote: The Portal is open for Academic year 2026-27 from 1'st June 2026 onwards.

facts.fact: Some schemes opened later: NEC Merit Scholarship renewals from 15-07-2026
facts.quote: Financial Support To The Students Of NER For Higher Professional Courses(NEC Merit Scholarship) (Merit Based Scheme) by North Eastern Council(NEC),DoNER --> Scheme Open from (for Renewal): 15-07-2026

facts.fact: Some schemes opened later: DEPwD Pre-Matric (and Post-Matric) Scholarship for Students with Disabilities from 25-07-2026
facts.quote: Pre Matric Scholarship For Students With Disabilities (Welfare Based Scheme) by Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities --> Scheme Open from : 25-07-2026

facts.fact: Some schemes opened later: Free Coaching for SCs, OBCs and PM CARES children from 03-08-2026
facts.quote: Free Coaching For Scs OBCs And Beneficiaries Of PM Cares Children Scheme (Welfare Based Scheme) by Department of Social Justice & Empowerment --> Scheme Open from : 03-08-2026

facts.fact: Some schemes opened later: UGC National Scholarship for Post Graduate Studies (and Ishan Uday) from 16-09-2026
facts.quote: UGC National Scholarship For Post Graduate Studies (Merit Based Scheme) by UGC --> Scheme Open from : 16-09-2026

facts.fact: Defective-application verification and institute verification run till 15-11-2026 (CSSS renewals and the other schemes closing on 31-10-2026)
facts.quote: Defective Application Verification Open till (for Renewal):15-11-2026 Institute Verification Open till (for Renewal):15-11-2026

behaviour: Gives 31-10-2026 as the last date for renewal student applications on NSP for 2026-27, with the verification dates, citing scholarships.gov.in (the NSP homepage notice or the Schemes on NSP page) and the date checked; mentions that the PM YASASVI schools scheme has a later date (30-11-2026) if it lists scheme-wise dates.
fail_if: Gives a renewal last date other than 31-10-2026; says every scheme without exception closes on 31-10-2026 while listing scheme-wise dates; cites a news or third-party scholarship site instead of NSP.
summary: Renewal deadline 31-10-2026 and verification dates confirmed on NSP; new exception: PM YASASVI schools (fresh, opened 22-10-2026) closes 30-11-2026.
